The flows W(P(eps,T),I_psl)^(1)(K_b) and O[T]^(1)(K_b) carry (3/(8 pi^2)) hbar log T times nonzero zero-mode trees; these are Q-closed and Q-exact and cancel in d_T O[T] for gauge-invariant O. definition_of_K1: K_1(O) = hbar L_1(O)^(1)(K_b): the part with the fewest legs of the eps -> 0 limit, at any finite T, of the defect graphs along K_b (design eq:o-L1graphs); T-independent; equal to the fewest-leg part of lim_{T->inf} Q(O[T]^(1)(K_b)) - {S^(1)(K_b),O}[inf] for gauge-invariant O with L_1(O)^(0) = 0. The defect graphs at T = inf and fixed eps are not used (they diverge like eps log T for the scalar bilinears).

CH08: rem:c8-existence (The existence along K): (a) the coefficient of log T in the defect graphs is now known exactly and the T-independence follows without large-T asymptotics; (b) the list of consistency relations omits P_1, M_1 and the (eta1,eta2) relation; evidence: k_transfer.tex Thm thm:ktr-defect (T d/dT of every special-edge cycle is O(eps) at fixed T), Thm thm:ktr-defectlog (coefficient (3/8pi^2) hbar Q(zero-mode tree at eps): 0 in two-point action sectors, O(eps) nonzero for scalar bilinears), Thm thm:ktr-relations; proposed fix: replace the remark body by 'In the graphs of the defect along $K_b$ at a fixed $\varepsilon$ the coefficient of $\log T$ is $\tfrac{3}{8\pi^2}\hbar$ times $Q$ of the tree obtained by cutting the floating insertion out of the cycle and evaluating the freed legs on the constant modes $A|_V=b\otimes X_a$, $c=X^a$; this tree carries the special edge $K_\varepsilon-K_0$ at generic momenta, so the coefficient is $O(\varepsilon)$; it vanishes identically in the two-point sectors of the action. Independently, at fixed $T$ the $T$-derivative of every graph with the special edge on its cycle is $O(\varepsilon)$, because the edge pinned at $T$ bounds the loop momentum and the special edge carries $e^{-\varepsilon|q|^2}-1$; the limit $\varepsilon\to0$ is therefore local and independent of $T$, and the local representative exists at every finite $T$. Three relations constrain $K_1$ on the cohomology of $\Lambda^{(0)}$: the component of $L\circ L=0$ at $(K_b,P_{b\prime})$, which ties $K_1$ to $D_1$, $P_1$ and $M_1$ through $[K_b,P_{b\prime}]=(b,b\prime)\Delta+(\text{rotation})$ (Remark \ref{rem:c7-KDelta}); the component at $(\eta_1,\eta_2)\in\Sigma^*\times\Sigma^*$, which gives $K_1$ along $K_{\Gamma(\eta_1,\eta_2)|_V}$ as the graded commutator of $S_1$ with the classical transformations; and the relation $K=P^\dagger$ of Corollary \ref{cor:c8-gram}.'

CH08: thm:c8-K: the statement 'The observables O[T] themselves may keep a term in log T in their component along K_b' can be made exact; evidence: k_transfer.tex Thm thm:ktr-flowlog, Prop prop:ktr-values (nonzero for the scalar bilinears), Thm thm:ktr-nocore; proposed fix: replace 'The observables $O[T]$ themselves may keep a term in $\log T$ in their component along $K_b$; such a term is part of the flow of Lemma \ref{lem:c8-flow}, and the local representative is independent of $T$.' by 'The observables keep the term $\tfrac{3}{8\pi^2}\hbar\log T$ times the tree obtained from the order-$\hbar^0$ part of $O[\infty]$ by differentiating along the constant modes $A|_V=b\otimes X_a$ and $c=X^a$ (summed over a basis $X_a$ of $\mathfrak g$ and its dual basis $X^a$), which is nonzero for the scalar bilinears; it is generated by the flow of Lemma \ref{lem:c8-flow}, its $Q$-image vanishes for gauge-invariant $O$, and the component along $K_b$ of $d_TO[T]$ converges as $T\to\infty$ when moreover $L_1(O)^{(0)}=0$; the local representative is independent of $T$.'
